# What the shop's binaries may reach, each with the reason.
cmd/api capability dial                # net/http's client comes with its server
cmd/api capability http-server         # it is the shop's web server
cmd/api capability listen              # it is the shop's web server
cmd/api capability reflect-call        # text/template calls what a page names
cmd/api reflect-method text/template   # the front page is a template; a renderer without one is owed
cmd/worker capability exec             # the nightly job is a shell command
